content: Empty your mind of all thoughts. Let your heart be at peace.
author: Lao Tzu
sourceWork: Tao Te Ching, Book of Virtue
story:
This insight touches directly on the messy reality of human nature. True art and creative work are not about clever technique; they demand total emotional skin in the game. When you create safely to please an audience or avoid criticism, the work feels hollow and bloodless.

In Lao Tzu's view, genuine strength is not an abstract theory—it is a lived, daily practice. Pouring your genuine spirit, vulnerability, and raw lived experience into what you make is what gives it enduring life. The work that resonates across centuries is always the work created with unapologetic personal truth.
reflectionPrompt: How can you create a moment of stillness today to reconnect with your deeper sense of purpose?
